predictions.bare-is-deck-local: a bare name set on deck 1 and deck 2 holds two independent values
predictions.dollar-is-global: a $ name set on deck 1 reads back the same from deck 2
predictions.prefixes-are-separate-names: bare, $ and @ forms of one name hold three different values at once
predictions.hash-is-the-bare-name: the table groups `name` and `#name`, so #X should read back what X was set to
predictions.percent-follows-the-logical-reference: %X under `deck left` is a different slot from %X under `deck 1`, even though left IS deck 1 — that is what "local to a logical deck reference" has to mean

summary.claim_scope: readbacks for one probe name per prefix; persistence is inferred from settings.xml, not a restart
